mu_name_from: MODEL_CRIMSONGLORY (MODEL_SHIELD + 17), loaded from Item/Shield_18.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:1116). Group 6 number 17 in OpenMU S6 Armors.cs:58.
why_this_one: The 100-140 gear MU has and this game lacked (the user, 2026-10-22: 'we need those low level items now', every class's but the Dark Lord's): the four second-class shields of Season 6's wave, beside the twelve weapons.
profile_from: The weapon profile, as every built shield uses.

stats.call_note: ArmorInitializerBase.CreateShield(number, slot, skill, width, height, name, dropLevel, defense, defenseRate, durability, levelRequirement, strengthRequirement, agilityRequirement, energyRequirement, vitalityRequirement, leadershipRequirement, darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel, magicGladiatorClassLevel, darkLordClassLevel, summonerClassLevel, ragefighterClassLevel); the group is slot + 5, 6.
stats.defense_rate_note: The shield's own block chance, which the fight does not roll yet. Recorded and unread.
stats.skill_note: The shield's block skill in OpenMU's table, carried for the row and nothing more.
stats.class_level_note: The Blade Knight's alone: OpenMU's darkKnightClassLevel 2. sim::fits asks Wearer::second (docs/game/second-class-gear.md).

sheet_from: Data/Item: CGshield_a.OZJ (128x128, dark red-brown plate with a silver band and gilt edging, mesh 0, 238 triangles), gra (256x64, a grey ramp, mesh 2, the steel rim, 104), already here; flareRed (64x64, a red star on black, mesh 1, 16, the gem at the boss) from Data/Effect/flareRed.OZJ, as Data/Item has none in this MuMain (Item/xmas/flareRed.OZJ is the same file). Decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py.
material_note: The face is MU's paint: painted_steel with the cast grain (a blade's brushed grain stripes plate). The rim is the gra ramp, bare steel.
glow_note: RenderPartObjectBody's MODEL_CRIMSONGLORY arm (ZzzObject.cpp:7225-7230): the body solid, then mesh 1 (flareRed, the gem) again RENDER_TEXTURE | RENDER_BRIGHT, added (ZzzBMD.cpp:1534), and mesh 2 (gra, the rim) again added with RENDER_CHROME. Here the gem solid and flareRed_glow, a copy of mesh 1's faces, added; the rim's pass is the chrome below. PartObjectColor gives it no Color.
chrome_from: The arm's pass of mesh 2, RENDER_TEXTURE | RENDER_BRIGHT | RENDER_CHROME (ZzzObject.cpp:7229), at the Flamberge's 0.3 as MU's stacked passes overshoot under our bloom. pipeline/chrome_sheets.py.
separate_meshes_why: flareRed_glow is mesh 1's own faces again; welded across meshes the two shells become duplicate faces and Blender keeps one (Wing05's trap, the Elemental Shield's WD_a_glow).
rig_note: Held, MuMain's arm is ZzzCharacter.cpp:8118-8144: gold BITMAP_LIGHTs on bones 4-10 and red flares breathing |sin(WorldTime*0.0005)| on 1-3 (fx/held_lights). export-rig --actions=all: twelve bones, one action of one key; nothing moves, no rig kept.
material_overrides_note: Steel at 0.45, as every broad flat piece passed in the studio: its own 0.2 mirrors the grass black.
